notes.title: Some more screenshots of what I've been working on recently!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here is a quick update to let you know I'm still alive and kicking, working on Derelicts!

Enjoy some screenshots I took while working!

- Some new enemies I added.
- A base players will be able to furnish and make is as cozy as they want to.
- Wildlife
- Mechanics like log flumes and wind turbines

I wish you a great week!

Romain
